thesis.summary: Only scaled US rare-earth mine + magnet plant. DoD price-floor backed.

catalyst.text: Independence magnet plant ramp; DoD price-floor & Apple deliveries; 10X facility

thesis.bull: Owner of Mountain Pass, the only scaled rare-earth mine in the US, now integrating downstream into separated oxides and NdFeB magnets — the part of the supply chain China dominates. A Department of Defense agreement underpinning a price floor and offtake materially de-risks the build-out and makes MP the cornerstone of US rare-earth reshoring.
thesis.bear: Rare-earth prices are set by a market China can flood at will, and a price war could pressure margins even with a DoD floor. The magnet thesis depends on executing a first-of-scale US magnet plant on time and on budget — manufacturing ramps of this kind frequently disappoint. Revenue is still concentrated in concentrate sales while the downstream ramps.
invalidationConditions: China sustains a rare-earth price war that overwhelms the DoD price-floor economics
The Independence magnet plant ramp slips materially or misses spec/yield
The DoD price-floor / offtake arrangement is curtailed
unknowns: Through-cycle margin once China pricing dynamics are accounted for
Magnet-plant yield, cost curve, and qualification timeline at commercial scale
Customer concentration of downstream magnet offtake beyond anchor agreements

evidence.claim: Operates Mountain Pass, the only scaled rare-earth mining & processing site in the US
Department of Defense agreement supporting a price floor and domestic magnet capacity
Physical mining + separation + magnet manufacturing — capital and permitting intensive, not software-replaceable
Building integrated NdFeB magnet production (Independence facility)
